name: Crypt Lord

facts.text: Level 86, 100,000 health, the highest-levelled named in Caer Sidi besides Apocalypse. Pulling him brings 43 linked dead: dark lights, fate's bearers, forerunners and reckoned souls.
The bounty quest's hunt reason says he commands Caer Sidi's restless dead.

story:
The Crypt Lord was Arawn's warden over the crypts of Caer Sidi, the deep rows where the prisoners slept between their reckonings. When the gaol rose he did not join the rising. He did something colder: he let the prisoners believe they had won, and then took command of them. Every forerunner, every dark light, every fate's bearer in his court answers to him now, and they come all at once. He is the gaol's real master under the riders, and he knows it.

The warden. The Crypt Lord was Arawn's warden over the deep rows, the crypts where the prisoners of Caer Sidi slept between their reckonings, and he was the best of Arawn's keepers until the day the gaol rose. He did not join the rising, and he did not resist it. He waited. He let the prisoners break the lesser keepers and believe they had won, and then he walked out among them and gave them orders, and they obeyed, because a prisoner who has won his freedom inside his prison still wants someone to tell him what to do with it.

His court. He keeps his court in the crypts now: dark lights and forerunners, fate's bearers and reckoned souls, forty-odd dead standing in ranks, and when he is struck all of them answer. He is the highest-levelled master in the fortress below the riders. The bounty-masters of Albion say he commands Caer Sidi's restless dead; the Inconnu say he commands them for himself, and that if Arawn ever retakes his gaol, the warden is the first he will want to speak to.
legend: Forty-odd dead come when he is pulled: dark lights, fate's bearers, forerunners and reckoned souls. Clear his court in sections from the edges before you touch him, or bring enough to fight a small army at once. He is level 86, the highest in the fortress below the riders; rotate tanks, and keep a full heal rotation on them. He resets a minute after the fight leaves him, so do not stall. Mark the forerunners first: they run, and they bring friends. The fate's bearers carry word upward to the riders, and the old hands swear Fames knows who killed them.

aggro: Rise, all of you. The warden calls the count.
You walk in my crypts uninvited.

phases.text: To me, every one of you! Hold the crypts!

loremasterTopic.text: Arawn's warden over the deep crypts. When the gaol rose he let the prisoners think they had won, and then took command of them. Clear his court before you strike him.

bookPage: We lost nine of eighty in the crypts before our raid leader learned to pull the warden's court in pieces. The dead stand there in ranks, rows upon rows, as if waiting for an inspection, and their lord walks among them. He did not shout when we came. He looked at us as a gaoler looks at new arrivals, and said that we walked in his crypts uninvited, and every head in every rank turned at once. The Inconnu say he was Arawn's best warden. I believe it. He is still a warden. He has only changed masters, and the master is himself.
